The '''Viscount''' was a model of [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] produced by [[Korrealis Systems]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Korrealis Viscount was added to the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with patch 4.5. and is available from a Community Cantina code.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''
